Name: Infectious and Undetectable by Standard Microscopy Humans
Uninfected and Protected by Antimalarial Prophylaxis Humans

Description: New human infections following bites from infectious mosquitoes; newly infected humans develop patent parasitaemia after a liver-stage delay, with a proportion developing symptoms.

Target: Uninfected and Protected by Antimalarial Prophylaxis Humans
Description: Mass treatment of uninfected individuals moves them into temporary prophylactic protection.
Symptomatic infections progress to asymptomatic infection in the absence of treatment or after treatment failure.
Successful treatment of symptomatic infections moves individuals into the treated infectious state.

Target: Infectious and Undetectable by Standard Microscopy Humans
Description: Asymptomatic patent infections progress to the subpatent state.
Mass treatment or screening-based treatment of asymptomatic infections moves individuals into the treated infectious state.
Screening-based treatment can target subpatent infections when PCR is used.
Treatment failures enter the asymptomatic infectious state.

Target: Uninfected and Protected by Antimalarial Prophylaxis Humans
Description: After parasite clearance, treated individuals may enter a protected prophylactic state depending on drug half-life.
Loss of prophylactic protection returns individuals to the susceptible uninfected state.
Mosquitoes become infected after biting infectious humans.
Extrinsic incubation progression from exposed to infectious mosquitoes.

Name: Drug efficacy
Description: Probability of full parasite clearance among treated individuals.
Value: 95-98% for antimalarials used in mass treatment; model often assumes 95%

Name: Coverage of mass drug administration
Description: Proportion of the population treated during MDA before exclusion of pregnant women.

Name: Coverage of artemisinin-combination therapies among symptomatic treated cases
Description: Fraction of symptomatic treated cases receiving ACTs.

Name: Coverage of non-ACT treatments among symptomatic treated cases
Description: Fraction of symptomatic treated cases receiving non-ACT treatments.

Name: Efficacy of non-gametocytocidal treatments
Description: Parasite clearance efficacy assumed for non-ACT treatments due to resistance.

Name: Efficacy of ACTs
Description: Parasite clearance efficacy assumed for ACTs.

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia in treated infection, non-artemisinins
Description: Duration of infectiousness after non-artemisinins.

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia in treated infection, ACT
Description: Duration of infectiousness after ACT treatment.

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia in treated infection, ACT-PQ
Description: Duration of infectiousness after ACT plus primaquine.

Name: Duration of inhibitory antimalarial blood concentration, short-acting drug
Description: Duration of prophylactic blood concentration for short-acting drugs.

Name: Duration of inhibitory antimalarial blood concentration, long-acting drug
Description: Duration of prophylactic blood concentration for long-acting drugs.

Name: Reduction in average infectiousness following treatment, non-artemisinins
Description: Reduction in infectiousness to mosquitoes compared with the pre-treatment state.

Name: Reduction in average infectiousness following treatment, ACT or ACT-PQ
Description: Reduction in infectiousness to mosquitoes compared with the pre-treatment state.

Name: Pregnancy prevalence among women aged 15-45
Description: Proportion of women of child-bearing age assumed pregnant and excluded from treatment.

Name: Pregnancy prevalence among population aged 15-45
Description: Population-level pregnancy prevalence used in the model.

Name: Correlation in individual participation between repeated rounds of MDA
Description: Degree to which the same individuals repeatedly participate or do not participate in successive MDA rounds.
